messages:
Mira: Hey folks — opened a docs PR with a tighter set of function-calling + structured-output examples. PR #789: concise examples + migration notes. Can @Sam take SDK snippet accuracy, @Alex please sanity-check parsing heuristics. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789

Sam: I can take the SDK bits. Quick ask: do we want Node + Python both, or only Node for this pass?

Alex: Node + Python please. Also add one example showing array-of-unions (common gotcha). Small schema + parse fallback.

Cheyenne: spotted a couple of broken internal links in the PR — will paste them in a sec. One is the old /tool-calling/anchor that got renamed.

Mira: thanks. I updated most links but missed that anchor. Cheyenne paste the path and I'll patch.

Cheyenne: broken link: /docs/tool-calling#examples -> should be /docs/tool-calling/overview#examples. Also the sample GIF 404s (cdn.redwood.ai/gifs/toolcall.gif).

Mira: got it. I'll remove the GIF and add the correct anchor.

Sam: grabbing SDK snippet from branch. Small change: in Node example we should use the new streaming helper and mention token-cost note. Suggest snippet:```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const resp = await client.call({
  model: 'redwood-alpha',
  input: 'Extract mentions and call a tool',
  tools: [/* tool config */],
  stream: true, // recommended for low-latency UIs
});
```

Alex: for parsing heuristics, add this JSON schema example and a short fallback guidance. Put as compact example in docs:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["lookup","create","delete"]},
    "args": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {"anyOf": [ {"type":"string"}, {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}}] }
    }
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```
Add note: when model outputs invalid shape, fallback to a simple regex extractor + tolerantly coerce arrays.

Mira: perfect. Also added a mini section on migration: old function-calling flag -> new tools array, with example diffs.

Sam: running the example lint smoke script now: `./scripts/check-examples.sh` — dev container shows one lint failure in python snippet (missing import).

Mira: I'll fix the Python snippet right away — thanks.

preview-bot: Preview site deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-789 — thumbnails and anchors rendered (status: success).

Cheyenne: quick nit — the compact schema example needs a short human explanation under it, otherwise readers skip it. Suggest a 1-sentence explanation + an edge-case note about nullable elements.

Mira: added a one-liner and nullable note.

Sam: LGTM from SDK side after the Python import fix. Left one inline comment about example using real API keys in sample — can we switch to env var placeholder everywhere?

Mira: yep changed to ENV placeholders.

Alex: Verified parser guidance, added one more sentence about graceful fallback to plaintext parse if JSON parse fails (link to parse runbook).

Mira: great. Thanks all. Can someone do a final quick read and then I will merge. My target: merge before EOD PST.

Sam: doing final read now. :thumbsup:

Cheyenne: quick scan done — fixed the anchor link and removed the GIF. +1 from me.

Sam: I've resolved my comments and ran examples smoke script again (all green).

Mira: merging now.

docs-bot: PR #789 merged by Mira into main (commit: 3f2b8d2). Release notes: docs: concise function/tool calling examples + migration guide.

Mira: thanks team! If any downstream SDK samples break, file a follow-up issue and tag me.

Alex: nice — we should snapshot these examples into the eval harness later.

Mira: adding a follow-up todo in the PR to track that.
